SELECT * FROM follow_up_sequence_threads
WHERE thread_id NOT IN (
    SELECT id 
    FROM follow_up_seq_email_threads_cache 
    WHERE id IS NOT NULL 
) and status not in ('6A', '8A')

update follow_up_sequence_threads
set status = '8A'
WHERE thread_id NOT IN (
    SELECT id 
    FROM follow_up_seq_email_threads_cache 
    WHERE id IS NOT NULL -- Crucial safety net!
) and status != '6A'
